preconditions.description: The input string length is at most 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c == '_' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, and underscores.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if sum(1 for name in ['Danil', 'Olya', 'Slava', 'Ann', 'Nikita'] if stdin.count(name) == 1) > 0 else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if exactly one of the specified friend names appears exactly once in the input string; otherwise output 'NO'.
